- memory_id "1000269" [constraint]: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000301" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
